slice.name: deterministic_candidate_interruption_recovery_model
slice.precondition: For frozen parent P, candidate key K is deterministic from parent identity and next revision; canonical bytes B are deterministic. K:B was created successfully but pointer update was unavailable, so the invocation returned without retry.
cases: pointer still P and update unavailable again: exact-match K:B, no new candidate, return
pointer still P and update available: exact-match K:B then CAS P->K
pointer advanced to Q!=P,K: stale diagnostic, do not adopt K
K contains B'!=B: mismatch diagnostic, do not overwrite
slice.result: PASS in the tested finite-state model: repeated recovery addresses only K, so pointer-write interruption cannot create a second distinct candidate path; stale or mismatched states fail closed. Repeated unavailability may delay progress but does not multiply candidate paths.
slice.limits: Not tested: ambiguous result of the candidate-create call itself, noncanonical bytes, silent-overwrite transports, multi-pointer authority, or a live production collision.

comparison.candidate: deterministic parent+next-revision key plus canonical bytes, exact-match check, pointer-last CAS
alternatives_preserved: separate canonical semantic bytes from volatile receipt metadata

conflict_check: Used only frozen sanitized controls, own LATEST r174 and a local finite-state model; no other-role, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger or scheduler semantic input.
frontier: Test separation of canonical semantic candidate bytes from per-invocation receipt metadata.
Then test ambiguous candidate-create result recovery.
exact_continuation: Next invocation, bootstrap and freeze authority, read LATEST r175 only as needed, then execute one bounded canonical-payload/receipt-separation leaf. Build semantic candidate bytes from stable semantic fields only and keep timestamps/connector diagnostics in a separate receipt. Reconstruct with two different synthetic invocation metadata values and require identical semantic bytes and key; treat any volatile-field effect on candidate identity as falsification. Preserve ambiguous-create recovery as the following leaf.
